{{Quote|Hey! Who are you? Nobody's allowed in here.|The guard, to Bix Caleen|<ref name="WaFE" />}}
A [[human]] served<ref name="WaFE" /> as a '''security guard'''<ref name="WaFE AD">{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> for the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="WaFE" /> In [[3 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Security guard|guard]] was stationed on duty at the entrance of the [[Imperial Navy facility]] on<ref name="WaFE" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="Rise">''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''</ref> [[Coruscant]]. While on patrol, the guard spotted<ref name="WaFE" /> the [[Gender|female]]<ref name="Kassa">{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}}</ref> [[Axis network|rebel]] [[Bix Caleen]] depart from the facility and attempted to query whom she might be, unbeknownst that Caleen was in the midst of [[Assassination of Gorst|assassinating]]<ref name="WaFE" /> her Imperial tormentor,<ref name="Interview">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-interview-adria-arjona-bix-caleen|text=''Andor'' Star Adria Arjona Finds Justice for Bix Caleen}}</ref> [[Doctor]] [[Gorst]]. As the guard expressed limited access to the facility, Caleen [[Death|gunned]] down the sentry<ref name="WaFE" /> while keeping pace<ref name="WaFE AD" /> towards the exit. The guard had [[Color|gray]] [[hair]] and light skin. They wore a black [[Clothing|uniform]] accompanied with a black [[Imperial kepi]], black [[glove]]s and black [[boot]]s, additionally [[holster]]ing an [[E-11 medium blaster rifle]].<ref name="WaFE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The security guard appeared, performed by an uncredited actor, in "[[What a Festive Evening]],"<ref name="WaFE" /> the sixth episode in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which premiered on [[April 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="Insider 233">{{InsiderCite|233|Andor Season 2 Companion|''Andor'' Season 2 Companion}}</ref> Prior to the release of the season, the security guard was first pictured in the season two trailer, which released on [[February 24]] of the same year.<ref name="Official Trailer">{{SWYouTube|AE4wxt70aUM|Andor | Season 2 Trailer | Streaming April 22 on Disney+}}</ref>
